name: Ben Bulben
text: Benbulbin (Irish: Binn Ghulbain), sometimes Benbulben or Ben Bulben, is a steep-sided and flat-topped mountain in County Sligo, Ireland. It is part of the Dartry Mountains, in an area sometimes called "Yeats Country". Benbulbin, 526 m (1,726 ft) high, formed as a nunatak during the last Ice Age.

depictions.name: Ben Bulben
depictions.text: Benbulbin Ben Bulben is a flat-topped rock formation in County Sligo of Connacht, Ireland. In Irish mythology, it served as the hunting ground of the led by Finn McCool. During her time in Ireland, in the late 9th century CE, Eivor Varinsdottir visited the location and built a cairn there.
